title: tanushbhootra576/TheSuperRAG
summary: TheSuperRAG是一个自修复的检索增强生成（RAG）后端，集成了混合搜索、重新排序、引用、置信度评分和实时文档管理。它使用FastAPI、LangChain、LangGraph和Qdrant提供高级文档摄取和聊天界面，支持高效的模型训练、推理和向量索引。
description: TheSuperRAG is a Self-Healing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) backend with hybrid search, re-ranking, citations, confidence scoring, and live document management.  It provides an advanced document ingestion and chat interface using FastAPI, LangChain, LangGraph, and Qdrant.
